subject: Oceanography
title: ROVs: Remotely Operated Vehicles
description: A short lesson to help you apply ROVs: Remotely Operated Vehicles.

hook.text: Why risk human lives at crushing depths when a robot tethered to a cable can do the job?

buildup.text: ROVs are unmanned submarines controlled from a ship via fiber-optic cable—sending live video back.

discovery.text: They can stay underwater for days, collecting samples, welding pipes, and filming in high definition.

twist.text: ROVs are critical for the oil and gas industry—inspecting and repairing equipment at 3,000+ meters.

climax.text: Jason, an ROV from Woods Hole, found the Titanic's debris field and has explored vents worldwide.

punchline.text: Robots explore the deep while humans stay safe above.

quiz.question: What is an ROV?
options: A remotely operated underwater vehicle controlled by cable
